text: The dihedral group Dₙ decomposes as a semidirect product ℤ/nℤ ⋊ ℤ/2ℤ, where the generator of ℤ/2ℤ acts on ℤ/nℤ by:
explanation: The reflection s conjugates the rotation r to r⁻¹ (srs⁻¹ = r⁻¹), which on ℤ/nℤ is k ↦ −k. A trivial action would give the abelian direct product ℤ/nℤ × ℤ/2ℤ, and k ↦ k+1 is not even an automorphism (it does not fix 0).
